changelog: [Never Segment]: added two generalized prohibitions targeting premature-commitment placements identified by the critic — (a) boundaries that isolate a bare NP/object repetition or embedded clause before its governing predicate (conditional, reported-speech, or hedging verb such as '같다/말하다/보다') has appeared, and (b) boundaries that isolate a short interjection/exclamatory fragment whose sense depends on an immediately following clarifying clause. These are wrong at any budget, not merely risky, so they belong in Never Segment rather than being merely ranked low.

[Decision Procedure]: Step 1 now explicitly instructs checking whether the clause's governing predicate (main, conditional, reporting, or hedging verb) has already surfaced before marking a boundary as a candidate, preventing fragments that will be contradicted once the governing verb arrives.
